title: GTA 6: everything Rockstar has confirmed 🎮
subject: gta6
description:
Standard or Ultimate edition? 👇

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard Edition $79.99, Ultimate Edition $99.99, boxed copies contain a download code, pre-load starts November 12 and purchases before November 20 include the Vintage Vice City Pack.

Sources: Rockstar Games, VideoGamer
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Everything Rockstar has confirmed about GTA 6, in 30 seconds.
It launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, and there's still no PC version announced.
Standard costs $79.99, Ultimate costs $99.99, and even boxed copies come with a download code instead of a disc.
Pre-load starts November 12, a full week early.
